points.point: R&S RTP and RTO6 oscilloscopes are positioned for satellite digital interface trigger, decode and debug — the clearest A&D oscilloscope use case in the Vault.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions satellite OBC validation, but not RTP/RTO6 satellite trigger/decode/debug as clearest use case

points.point: The covered bus standards are the space/avionics set: SpaceWire, 8b/10b SpaceFibre, MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN, I²C/SPI, UART.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not list SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN, I²C/SPI, UART

points.point: Multi-domain correlation (RF link + DC power + datacom bus on one 4-channel scope) is the differentiating value proposition for satellite debug.
points.label: missing
points.why: no RF/DC/datacom multi-domain correlation value proposition

points.point: A concrete named satellite-chain lead exists: 精英電腦 under satellite control board / OBC is mapped to 'Oscilloscope'.
points.label: covered
points.why: names 精英電腦 OBC/control-board mapped to Oscilloscope

points.point: Spacecraft OBC hardware actually carries CAN, SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553B, RS422 and LVDS interfaces, which is the technical basis for the scope need.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: says vault does not identify satellite OBC interface buses

points.point: UAV camera / image-processing high-speed serial links (GMSL, LVDS) at 邑錡 are mapped to R&S RTO and R&S MXO.
points.label: covered
points.why: 邑錡 GMSL/LVDS mapped to RTO and MXO

points.point: UAV battery/power and motor/gimbal segments give further MXO leads (德鑫新技, 其昜先進).
points.label: covered
points.why: 其昜先進 motor/gimbal and 德鑫新技 battery/power mapped to MXO

points.point: These mappings are leads only — the Vault prohibits inferring purchase, use, deployment, evaluation or certification by the named companies.
points.label: partial
points.why: states lack of procurement/customer evidence, but not full prohibition on use/deployment/evaluation/certification
